function renderLine( line, pattern)
    for i=1, strlen(pattern) do
        local c = strsub( pattern, i, i)
        if c =="#" then
            set_stone( "st-greenbrown", i-1, line)
        elseif c =="r" then
            set_stone( "st-invisible", i-1, line)
            abyss(i-1,line)
        elseif c == "o" then
            oxyd( i-1, line)
        elseif c =="." then
            set_floor( "fl-hay", i-1, line)
            -- Mark original positions of abysses
        elseif c=="z" then
            set_actor("ac-blackball", i-.5,line+.5)
        end
    end
end

  for i=1,12 do t2=t2+tab2[i] end

  if unable==0 then

     if t1>1 then

     else
      los=1
     end
    end
    test2=0
    for i=1,6 do test2=test2+tab2[i] end
    if test2>0 then
      BB_choice=7
      score=0
      to_choose=0
      for n=1,6 do
        BB_choice=BB_choice-1
        gsum=tab2[BB_choice]

        if gsum>0 then
          repeat
            jj=jj+1
            if jj==13 then jj=1 end
            if gsum>1 then gsum=gsum-1 end
          until gsum <= 1
          if score<tab1[jj] then score=tab1[jj] to_choose=BB_choice end

      end
      if score>0 then

      else
        repeat
          r=random(6)

        BB_choice=r
      end
      sow2(BB_choice)
    else
     if t2>1 then

      to_choose=0

          if score<tab1[jj] then score=tab1[jj] to_choose=BB_choice end

     else

     end
    end

  elseif t1<=1 then

  end
  display_game()

  if won==1 then

  end
  if los==1 then
    document(20,10,"text18")

 else -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- awale version
  my_goods=0

    else

    for i=7,12 do -- Big Brother tries to avoid a danger -- -- -- -- -- -- -- -- --

  error1=0

    empty2=0

  else
    error1=1

  if error1==0 and tab1[j]>1 then

function sow2(case)

    compt2=tab2[case]

    j=case
    repeat
      j=j+1
      if j==13 then j=1 end
      tab2[j]=tab2[j]+1
      compt2=compt2-1
    until compt2 <= 0
    if tab2[j]>1 and won==0 then
      sow_take2(j)
    end
  end
end

function sow_take2(case)
  if tab2[case]>0 and won==0 then
    compt2=tab2[case]
    tab2[case]=0
    if case>6 then
    empty1=0
    for i=1,6 do empty1=empty1+tab1[i+6] end
      if empty1>0 then
      compt2=compt2+tab1[19-case]
      tab1[19-case]=0
      else
      compt2=compt2+tab1[13-case]
      tab1[13-case]=0
      end
    end
    j=case
    repeat
      j=j+1
      if j==13 then j=1 end
      tab2[j]=tab2[j]+1
      compt2=compt2-1
    until compt2 <= 0
    if tab2[j]>1 and won==0 then
      sow_take2(j)
    end
  end
end


function reset()
  gain1=0
  gain2=0
  dammit1=1
  hurra1=1
  won=0
  bouh=0
  for i=1,12 do
    tab[i]=4
    tab1[i]=2
    tab2[i]=2
    ghost[i]=0
  end
  display_game()
  my_choice=random(6)
  if difficult then BB_choice=random(6) else BB_choice=6+random(6) end
  won=0
  los=0
end

texts.text1: The witch of this switch waits for your wish.
texts.text2: The witch of this switch resets the awale game.
texts.text3: A turn consists in taking the walnuts of a row behind the windowy walls and sowing them 1 by 1 in the following rows.
texts.text4: Warning: What awaits the wailing warrior at the end of a turn? If there are 2 or 3 walnuts in a row, they are a warm award for the warrior, as are the walnuts in the rows which are in the way to this row, if they are 2 or 3 per row.
texts.text5: Warning: If one warrior's walls are empty, this awesome warrior wins.
texts.text6: When a warrior has awarded more than half the walnuts, he wins. What does he win? The way to the waiting oxyds he wants.
texts.text7: Congratulations! You are the most aware awale player of the valley ...
texts.text8: Lost in the savannah? Don't wait and walk on the way to the reset switch on the far left ...
texts.text11: A turn consists in taking the stones of a row and sowing them 1 by 1 in one's other rows, counterclockwise, coming back to the beginning.
texts.text12: At the end of a turn, if the last stone falls in a nonempty row, one takes the stones of the facing row if there is any, and repeats a turn.
texts.text13: A turn begins in one of the leftmost rows, unless impossible.
texts.text14: At the end of the game (if one player cannot move anymore), the player who has the most stones wins.
texts.text15: A yellow stone stands for 10 blue stones (then for 2 brown stones).
texts.text16: A brown stone stands for 5 blue stones.
texts.text17: This katro game comes from Madagascar; in Easy mode there is an african Awale.
texts.text18: Only reset or Shift-F3 can make things evolve ...

wo["ConserveLevel"] = false

ti[" "] = {"fl_lawn"}
ti["-"] = {"fl_samba"}
ti["#"] = {"st_purplegray"}
ti["X"] = ti["-"] .. {"st_door", flavor="a", state=OPEN, name="doors#"}
ti[">"] = {"st_mirror", flavor="triangle", orientation=EAST}
ti["M"] = {"st_mirror", orientation=SLASH}
ti["N"] = {"st_mirror", orientation=BACKSLASH}
ti["<"] = {"st_laser", state=ON, orientation=WEST}
ti["W"] = {"st_door", flavor="b", name="doorsl%%#"}
ti["Q"] = ti["-"] .. {"st_quake", name="blinker#"}
ti["S"] = ti["-"] .. {"st_switch", target="check"}
ti["t"] = ti["-"] .. {"it_trigger", name="trigger", target="generate", _length=1}
ti["T"] = {"st_timer", name="timer", state=OFF, target="blink", interval=1.0, _state=1}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd"}
ti["@"] = ti["-"] .. {"#ac_marble_black"}

wo(res.autotile(ti, {"1", "8", "W"}), " ", {
    "                    ",
    " Q####Q####Q M5678O ",
    " #S---S---S# 4      ",
    " #---------# 3      ",
    " #--XXXXX--# 2      ",
    " #--X---X--# 1      ",
    " QS@X-t-X-SQ >  < T ",
    " #--X---X--# 1      ",
    " #--XXXXX--# 2      ",
    " #---------# 3      ",
    " #S---S---S# 4      ",
    " Q####Q####Q N5678O ",
    "                    "})

local sequence = {}
local semaphor = false

function generate(value, sender)
    if value == true and semaphor == false then
        semaphor = true
        no["doors#*"]:close()
        blinker = no["blinker#*"]:shuffle()
        sequence = {}
        for i = 1, sender["_length"] do
            sequence[i] = blinker[i]
        end
        no["timer"]["_state"] = 1
        no["timer"]:on()
    end
end

function blink(value, sender)
    if sender["_state"] <= #sequence then
        sequence[sender["_state"]]:toggle()
        sender["_state"] = sender["_state"] +1
    else
        sender:off()
        no["doors#*"]:open()
    end
end

local number = 1    -- which step of the sequence to check as next

function check(value, sender)
    qua = no["blinker#*"]:nearest(sender)
    if qua == sequence[number] then
        qua:toggle()
        number = number +1
    else
        -- the sequence was wrong
        no["doorsl*"]:close()
        no["trigger"]["_length"] = 1    -- start again with sequence of length 1
        sequence = {}
        number = 1
        semaphor = false    -- allow us to request a new challenge
        return    -- to assure we get no problems with sequences of length 1
    end
    -- finally, the whole sequence was right
    if number == #sequence +1 then
        no["doorsl%"..#sequence.."#*"]:open()
        no["trigger"]["_length"] = no["trigger"]["_length"] +1    -- next sequence will be 1 longer
        sequence = {}
        number = 1
        semaphor = false    -- allow us to request a new challenge
    end
end

wo["ConserveLevel"] = false
wo["AllowSingleOxyds"] = true

number_lasers = cond(wo["IsDifficult"], 5, 3)

ti[" "] = {"fl_sand"}
ti["#"] = {"st_fake_oxyda"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd", "oxyd#", flavor = "a"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble", "marble", adhesion = 1}

ti["T"] = {"st_timer", target = "timer_callback", interval = 1.0}
ti["n"] = {"fl_sand", "border_north#", _laser = "S", _dir = po(-1,0)}  .. ti["#"]
ti["e"] = {"fl_sand", "border_east#",  _laser = "W", _dir = po(0,-1)}  .. ti["#"]
ti["s"] = {"fl_sand", "border_south#", _laser = "N", _dir = po(1,0)}   .. ti["#"]
ti["w"] = {"fl_sand", "border_west#",  _laser = "E", _dir = po(0,1)}   .. ti["#"]
ti["1"] = {"fl_sand", "border_north#", _laser = "S", _dir = po(-1,1)}  .. ti["#"]
ti["2"] = {"fl_sand", "border_east#",  _laser = "W", _dir = po(-1,-1)} .. ti["#"]
ti["3"] = {"fl_sand", "border_south#", _laser = "N", _dir = po(1,-1)}  .. ti["#"]
ti["4"] = {"fl_sand", "border_west#",  _laser = "E", _dir = po(1,1)}   .. ti["#"]
ti["N"] = {"st_laser", state = ON, orientation = NORTH}
ti["E"] = {"st_laser", state = ON, orientation = EAST}
ti["S"] = {"st_laser", state = ON, orientation = SOUTH}
ti["W"] = {"st_laser", state = ON, orientation = WEST}

w, h = wo(ti, " ", 
       {"#1nnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn#",
        "w                  2",
        "w                  e",
        "w                  e",
        "w                  e",
        "w                  e",
        "w        @T        e",
        "w                  e",
        "w                  e",
        "w                  e",
        "w                  e",
        "4                  e",
        "#sssssssssssssssss3#"})

border_north = no["border_north#*"]:shuffle()
border_east  = no["border_east#*"]:shuffle()
border_south = no["border_south#*"]:shuffle()
border_west  = no["border_west#*"]:shuffle()

-- Set 8 Oxyd Stones according to some rules, such that
-- the lasers can't open all of them.
wo[border_north:sub(2)] = ti["O"]
wo[border_south[1]] = ti["O"]
if border_south[1].x == border_north[1].x then
    wo[border_south[2]] = ti["O"]
else
    wo[po(border_north[1].x, border_south[1].y)] = ti["O"]
end
wo[border_west:sub(2)] = ti["O"]
wo[border_east[1]] = ti["O"]
if border_east[1].y == border_west[1].y then
    wo[border_east[2]] = ti["O"]
else
    wo[po(border_east[1].x, border_west[1].y)] = ti["O"]
end

wo:shuffleOxyd()

-- Now set initial lasers, but not on oxyds and such that the
-- marble isn't destroyed in the beginning:
mx, my = no["marble"]:xy()
oxyds = fl(po(no["oxyd#*"]))
free_border = (border_north + border_east + border_south + border_west) - oxyds
laser_pos = free_border - grp(fl(mx, 0), fl(mx, h-1), fl(0, my), fl(w-1, my))
laser_pos = (laser_pos:shuffle()):sub(number_lasers)
for i = 1, #laser_pos do
    wo[laser_pos[i]] = ti[fl(laser_pos[i])._laser]
end

-- Move lasers on timer call:
function timer_callback()
    wo[laser_pos - oxyds] = ti["#"]
    local new_pos = grp()
    for floor in laser_pos do
        new_pos = new_pos + fl(floor + floor._dir)
    end
    laser_pos = new_pos
    for floor in laser_pos - oxyds do
        wo[floor] = ti[floor._laser]
    end
end
